scene_target: The party completes a gathering quest, and Rhea discovers a mathematical discrepancy in the System's payouts.
goal: Complete a standard gathering quest in the Ash Thickets to test the new party contract.
conflict: The quest rewards are exactly 14.3% lower than the System's stated base rates, revealing a systemic skim.
end_condition: Rhea identifies a consistent 14.3% deficit in their quest rewards compared to the raw System formulas.
transition_in_text: The newly formed party leaves the Collapsed Transit Tunnel and enters the Ash Thickets to test their contract on a gathering quest.
transition_out_text: Rhea realizes the math on their XP and loot yields is wrong, setting up an investigation into the missing 14.3%.

last_scene: The party completed a gathering quest in the Ash Thickets.
Rhea discovered a discrepancy between the System's stated base rewards and the actual payout.
She calculated a silent 14.3% deficit in both XP and loot, indicating a systemic skim.
key_events: The party defeated an ash-boar during a standard gathering quest.
Rhea obtained a Severed Ash-Boar Tusk and 60 Copper Credits.
Rhea compared the actual payout to the raw System Formulas.
She identified a hidden 14.3% skim on all quest rewards.
